explanation: It is near 0 at every D1 and D2 step and at GO when the agent chooses a1, and it fires only at GO when the agent chooses a2 right after an unrewarded trial during a run of a2 choices in the middle of the episode (about trials 40-75): about 10 for the first loss after rewarded a2 trials, and about 7 if a second loss follows straight away. It stays 0-1 at GO for a2 after a rewarded trial, and also 0 for a2 after a loss early in the episode (before about trial 35) or late in it (after about trial 80).
